usedFor: Narrato is where content tasks start, and “Copy a File” gives each one a Google Drive document.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task” in Narrato, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: New tasks get a copy of a file, optionally renamed, so writers start from the same base.

watchOut: “Update Task” fires on every edit, so “Copy a File” can run again for the same task.
